item.title: Contact
item.description:
Talk

Got a question? Wanna talk to a person? Wanna release something?

Send a message to @mlemrecords on indieweb.social. Or send an electronic mail to hi@mlemrecords.com or support@mlemrecords.com.

Demos

If you’re interested in releasing music and you’re a cool person, we’d love to help out! If you send us files, please send publicly accessible links that we can stream from and a short message about you and your intentions.

Hit us up at demos@mlemrecords.com.
